t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Mushrooms will either be consistent or vary.  If they're consistent, a well-performing mushroom will always perform well.  If they vary, a well-performing mushroom may become a poorly-performing mushroom later in the same round.

vb_textbox.text: One mushroom is worth more than another.  Which mushroom is worth the most can either remain consistent, or it can change within the round.  Use the 1x trials to set yourself up for the 5x ones.
